integrity: Claim, proof, independent adjacency-based small-case checks and limitations provided. A same-model mathematical review is recorded, not independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to ordinary secure coalitions of F_m=K_1 join mK_2, m>=2. The quotient test characterizes all eligible partitions but does not give a closed enumeration of all optimizers. General windmills with larger cliques are not addressed. Historical priority remains provisional; independently validated mathematics is not claimed.
title: Five secure coalition classes in every friendship graph
